translation: To Amurrum-bāni, Aššur-imittī, Ṣilūlu, Šu-Kūbum, Ennam-ilī, Aššur-dan, Ilī-bāni, Enna-Suen, Šar-Adad and Zikiki from Šalim-Aššur:

translation: They went on: "Abu-šalim must come. If Abu-šalim is absent, his master must travel. Here we fear for our lives and Abu-šalim's silver." When all of the envoys from the City and the Kanesh colony had heard their letters,

translation: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

translation: We are well, we are staying in Tawiniya. We hear rumors that the residents of Wahšušana have left the city.

translation: The plenary assembly of the colony passed a verdict, stating that Šalim-Aššur and Šu-Bēlum on this very day must make declarations, and they must discuss in order to come to an agreement; further they must deposit the tablet from the City assembly and of the men who settled their affair before the judges.

translation: The colony has passed a verdict stating that Šalim-Aššur must mention to the sons of Iddin-abum his tablets for his witnesses to how much silver-all the silver-he has paid to cover Iddin-Abum's debt. He is to say:"This silver I paid in different places."

translation: From the hamuštum of Amur-Ištar he has 20 weeks to pay.

translation: If by the full term he has not paid 1 ½ shekels per month per mina will be added.

translation: Thus Aššur-šad-ilē, Amur-Ištar, Tāb-ṣilli-Aššur, Ilī-anum, Anuppiya, and Ababayai, say to Kuliya:

translation: We have settled your affair concerning Sabasiya's house, considering the fact that a term had been set for you.

transliteration: i-na na-áp-ṭí-ir ku-nu-tí ù a-na-ku ú-lá ša ki-ma qá-qí-dí-a a-ṭa-ra-dam-ma mì-li-ik lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR a-ma-lik
translation: At the opening of snows, then I shall send either myself or someone I can rely on, and I shall make a decision about the merchant's goods.

transliteration: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma tí-ir-tí DAM.GÀR hi-mì-tum i-li-kam
translation: What is that you wrote, saying: "A heated letter from the merchant came.

transliteration: a-na-ku sà-ah-ra-ku-ma a-na lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR mì-li-ik-ša ma-lá-kam lá a-al-té-e ba-a-nim i-a-tí ta-ša-pá-ra-am a-pu-t
translation: I have personally been delayed and been unable to take any decision about the merchant's goods." Come on, it is to me you write! Urgent, guard the goods of the merchant;

translation: From the merchant to Ennam-Aššur, Damiq-pī-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

translation: My dear brothers, as for every shekel of silver you have received from my outstanding claims or that has been cleared from my goods - send Damiq-pī-Aššur to me (with it) <gap>

transliteration: a-dí <gap> i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-a-ni ṭù-ur-da-šu
translation: Orphan! Send him the very day you hear my letter!

transliteration: i-na pá-ni-tim <gap>-ga-<gap> tám-kà-ri-im KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN tù-šé-ṣí-a ù i-na lu-qú-tim KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-a-am
translation: Earlier <gap> of the merchant <gap> you realised every shekel of silver, and silver was cleared for me from my goods.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR tù-ša-aṣ-bi-ta-ma a ma-lá na-áš-pé-er-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im lá tù-ša-as-ha-ra-ni
translation: You have had the silver seized, and in accordance with the message from the merchant you must not delay me.

translation: Arrange a caravan trip for me and encourage the merchant, so his ill-wishers will not multiply.

translation: Damiq-pī-Aššur said: "Now, I have informed you about the copy of the missive that I am bringing."

translation: Ennam-Aššur son of Sukkalliya has received 18 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

translation: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Dudiki, by Tūraya son of Uzuwa, by Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum.

translation: Atata seized us against Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Anum and Atata said:

translation: Look here, 3000 (minas of) copper the ruler of Wahšušana has promised to pay to you as a final settlement.

translation: You would see to it that the silver paid for it would reach me in the City.

transliteration: a-ta ta-kà-al ší-im-tám a-na-ku a-lá-qé
translation: You would enjoy the profit on it and I would obtain the capital sum.

transliteration: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR ší-im URUDU a-na a-lim{ki} ù-ša-ak-ša-da-ku-ma ší-ma-am a-ša-a-ma né-ma-lam a-na-ku a-kà-al
translation: Ennam-Suen answered: I would see to it that the silver paid for the copper reaches you in the City and I would make purchases (with it) and the profit (on it) I would enjoy.

translation: In the presence of Nab-Suen, son of Pilah-Ištar, of Malik-ennam, the scribe.

transliteration: a-na i-ku-<gap> ú zu-zu-wa qí-bi-ma um-ma a-lá-bu-ma
translation: To Iku <gap> and Zuzuwa, thus Ali-abum:

transliteration: mì-nam áš-ta-na-me-ú a-mur-IŠTAR É-tí ú-da-lu-hu
translation: What is this that I hear by rumor, that Amur-Ištar is troubling my household?

transliteration: a ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na im-hi-ṣí-ni
translation: He has harmed me for an amount of 10 minas of silver!

transliteration: a-ma-kam a-mur-IŠTAR i-na É-be-tim ṭù-ur-da
translation: Over there chase Amur-Ištar out of the house.

transliteration: <gap>-bi-i <gap> iš-tí i-na-a-a ṭá-hi-a-šu-ma a-na kà-ri-im li-im-šu-ur-šu
translation: <gap> confront him with Innāya, so that the latter can coax him along to the kārum.

transliteration: a-hu-ú-a-tù-nu a ṣé-er ṣú-ha-ar-tim ú É-be-tim e-ku-nu li-li-ik am-tum i-ha-li-iq
translation: Please, my brothers, keep an eye on the girl and on the house. The maid might perish!

transliteration: KIŠIB kà-ri-im ha-hi-im kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
translation: The Hahhum colony has passed a verdict: The colony passed a verdict:

transliteration: šu-ma šu-be-lúm ù en-na-sú-in me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi4-im lá i-li-ku-ú-ma iš-tí šál-ma-a-šùr lá i-na-me-ru-ú-ma a-li i-ma-gu5-ru-ni lá e-ta-wu-ú lu-qú-tám a-na šál-ma-a-šùr ú-šu-ru-ú a-ba pá-šé-er a-wa-tim
translation: If Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen, Iddin-abum's sons, do not leave and meet with Šalim-Aššur and do not discuss in order to come to an agreement, then they must release the goods to Šalim-Aššur. Aba was the arbitrator.

transliteration: a-na ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi4-im DUB i-dí-na-bi4-im DUMU šu-IŠTAR GUDU4 ša IŠTAR
translation: To Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, tablet of Iddin-abum, son of Šu-Ištar, priest of Ištar.

transliteration: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma i-dí-na-bu-um-ma
translation: Say to Kuliya. (seal of Iddin-abum) Thus says Iddin-abum: (seal of Iddin-abum)

translation: 10 shekels of silver for which Urdum, our servant, and Ennum-ilī had become indebted to Puzur-Aššur, son of Ahu-waqar - if I deliver to you a letter of Ataya, stating that you have settled accounts and have collected that silver, will you then release to me the letter with my seal?

transliteration: um-ma ku-li-a-ma šu-ma na-áš-pè-er-tám lá ta-ta-áb-lam 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-ša-qá-lam
translation: Kuliya answered: If you do not deliver to me that letter you shall pay me 10 shekels of silver.

transliteration: ra-da-<gap> a be-e-tim na-ší šál-ma-ni ú ṣú-ùh-ru-um ša-lim
translation: <gap> is bringing to the house. We are well and the youngsters are well.

translation: With your scarfs, which you left behind, and those which Šamaš-bāni left behind, Šu-Anum is on his way to the house.

translation: Sealed by Uraya son of Manana, by Ili-dan son of Iddin-Aššur, by Mannum-balum-Aššur son of Ikbum.

translation: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: ma-ma-hi-ir i-šu ITU.KAM ku-zal-li li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a a-na ša-na-at i-ša-qal šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na 10 ma-na-e 1 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
translation: Iddin-abim s. Aššur-bani owes Man-mahir 20 minas refined copper. He will pay one year from the month of Kuzallī, eponymate Buzutaya. If he does not pay (on time), he will add 10 minas per mina per month.

transliteration: ma-la lu-qú-tum a-na a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim i-pí-iq-du-ma ša-lim-a-šùr ú-šé-ṣí-ú šu-ma a-na šu-ku-bi-im ma-ma-an i-tù-a-ar ša-lim-a-šùr ú-ba-áb-šu
translation: With regard to what goods had been entrusted to Aššur-bēl-awātim and which Šalim-Aššur had taken out, if anyone raises claim against Šu-Kūbum, Šalim-Aššur will clear him.

transliteration: a-na É šál-ma-a-šùr a-na a-wa-tim né-ru-ub-ma
translation: We entered Šalim-Aššur's house to settle the case,

transliteration: um-ma šál-ma-a-šùr-ma i-a-tí a-na bu-ru-uš-ha-dim i-na ma-ak-sú-e-im a-na hu-bu-ul ÌR a-bu-ša-lim ša-qá-lim i-ra-de8-ú-ni a-ta 30 TÚG ku-ta-ni ù ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am ša ÌR ta-lá-qé-e
translation: and Šalim-Aššur said: "While they are going to lead me personally to Burušhaddum in fetters to pay the debt of the slave Abu-šalim, will you on the other hand take 30 kutānu-textiles and a black donkey from the slave?"

transliteration: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na ša ÌR-dí-a a-bu-ša-lim al-qé ša-lim-a-šur ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} úz-na-tí-ni il5-pu-ut
translation: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I have taken what belongs to my slave Abu-šalim." Šalim-Aššur impressed on us what had been sworn by the City, and Šalim-Aššur said:

transliteration: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma a-šar ÌR a-na ÌR-dí-kà lá i-tù-ru-ú ma-a a-na ÌR-dí-a i-tù-wa-ar
translation: and Šalim-Aššur said: "In case the slave does not raise claim against your slave, then, will he raise claims against my slave?"

transliteration: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma šu-ma a-na ku-a-im i-tù-a-ar a-na TÚG.HI.A ù ANŠE.HI.A a-za-za-kum a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
translation: Šu-Bēlum answered: "If he raises claim against yours, then I guarantee for the textiles and the donkey for you." The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in IGI ú-ra-a IGI ì-lí-dan IGI ma-ni-um-ba-lúm-a-šùr
translation: Witnessed by Uraya, by Ilī-dan, by Man-num-balum-Aššur.

transliteration: a-na ší-ip-ri ša a-lim{ki} ù kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er-GAL qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
translation: To the envoys of the City and the plenary assembly of Kanesh colony;

transliteration: bé-lu-a a-tù-nu ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ha-dim ṣa-he-er GAL ù ṭup-pá-am ša ú-ší-na-lam DUB.SAR ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ha-dim DUMU i-ba-a ù ṣú-ha-ru-um ša ú-ší-na-lam a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er GAL a-šu-mì a-bu-ša-lim ÌR ub-lu-nim-ma
translation: From Šalim-Aššur: My dear lords, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony, Ibaya's son, and a servant of Ušinalam brought a tablet from the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony and a tablet from Ušinalam to the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony concerning the slave Abu-šalimm,

transliteration: um-ma šu-nu-ma 16 li-me 40 ma-na URUDU ší-im SÍG.HI.A a-bu-ša-lim ÌR a-na ú-ší-na-lam ha-bu-ul 30 li-me URUDU ša nam-e-dim ša e-kál-lim ha-bu-lu ú-ší-na-lam ú-ṣa-li-im um-ma šu-nu-ma a-bu-ša-lim li-li-kam šu-ma a-bu-ša-lim lá-šu be-el-šu li-li-kam a-na-kam a-na na-áp-ša-tí-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR-áp <gap> a-bu-ša-lim ni-ša-hu-ut
translation: and they said: "The slave Abu-šalim owes 16,040 minas of copper, the price of wool, to Ušinalam. As to the 30,000 minas of copper from the others that they owe to the palace, he has angered Ušinalam."

transliteration: ší-ip-ru ša a-lim ku-lu-šu-nu-ma ù kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er GAL ṭup-pí iš-ta-me-ú-ma
translation: All of the envoys from the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony heard this

transliteration: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-li-ik-ma ú-ší-na-lam tù-ṭá-áb a qá-tí ili5-ba-ni hu-ra-ṣa-num DUB.SAR ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ha-dim ú ṣú-ha-ri-im ša
translation: and you said "You must go and satisfy Ušinalam." You handed me over to Ilī-bāni, Huraṣānum, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony and Ušinalam's servant together with my merchandise that had arrived from the City,

transliteration: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im DUMU a-šùr-i-dí KIŠIB i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-i-dí sú-in-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr tap-pá-i-ni
translation: Sealed by Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī, by Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-idī; Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur was our (absent) partner.

transliteration: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
translation: The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

transliteration: ša hu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im 13 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša kàr-ri-a
translation: The debt of Iddin-abim is 13 minas refined silver.

transliteration: a-na 36 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1½ GÍN.TA
translation: From the hamuštum of Qarwiya he has 36 weeks to pay.

transliteration: i-na ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb ša a-mur-IŠTAR ù a-šùr-i-mì-tí
translation: If he does not pay 1 ½ shekels will be added per month per mina by Amur-Ištar and Aššur-imittī.

transliteration: mì-li-ik lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im mì-il5-kà
translation: <gap> take a decision concerning (the textiles) belonging to the merchant.

transliteration: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-na mu-a-tim ta-ad-nu-ma É a-šùr-bé-el-a-wa-tim wa-áš-bu ša ki-ma ili5-ba-ni ÌR ù tám-kà-ru-šu e-ru-bu-ma
translation: When Iddin-abum was dying and was staying in Aššur-bēl-awātim's house, the representatives os Ilī-bāni, Wardum and his customers, came in(to the house) and

translation: Ilī-bāni's representatives said: "Settle accounts with us!"-

translation: but Iddin-abum answered: "Hold your tablets ready, for my tablets are written and available. Let my brother Šalim-Aššur come, and then settle with him. Then my own representatives, Šu-Illil and Amur-Ištar may assist my brother. Until my brother arrives no one may open my tablets."

translation: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

translation: Witnessed by Akuza, by Lā-qēp, by Silūlu.

translation: Sealed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum, by Uraya son of Manana, by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Lā-qēpum son of Illil-bāni, by Itūr son of Amur-Ištar.

translation: 2 donkeys, for 33 shekels of silver, 2 donkeys for 25 ½ shekels of silver, 1 ½ shekel of silver from the price of a textle, when he bought a tisābu-garment for his wife - in all 1 mina of silver due from alutani Huanālum, witnessed by Hunadadua, his son-in-law and the <gap> of Alutani, and by Bazazaya.

translation: 45 shekels of silver, the price of 2 donkeys Ašdunani Hušanālum owes, witnessed by Hunadadu, by Hurdunani, by Bazazaya.

transliteration: ½ ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 e-ma-re i li-bi ba-za-za-a IGI ur-dim IGI a-li-a
translation: ½ mina of silver, the price of 2 donkeys, owed by Bazazaya, witnessed by Urdum, by Aliya.

translation: All together: 3 minas and 9 shekels, your silver, they will pay in spring.

transliteration: ṭup-pu-ú ha-ru-mu-tum ša ší-bi-a ša me-er-e i-dí-a-bi4-im
translation: Certified tablets with my witnesses concerning the sons of Iddin-abum.

transliteration: a-lim <gap> be-lá-nim <gap> KIŠIB a-ta-ta <gap>
